description: This file implements a generic directory cache class with associated types and utility functions. It manages caching of entries with an expiration mechanism, size eviction, and configuration-aware resets.

classes.name: DirectoryCache
classes.description: A generic cache class with TTL and size limit, supporting configuration-based reset and expiration cleanup.

methods.name: export function buildDirectoryCacheKey(key: DirectoryCacheKey): string { buildDirectoryCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a string key from a DirectoryCacheKey object, incorporating default signature if none provided.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the cache with TTL and maximum size parameters.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value for a given key if it exists and is valid; resets cache if configuration has changed.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache associated with a key, updating expiry and respecting configuration changes.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.clearMatching
methods.description: Clears cache entries whose keys match a given predicate.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.clear
methods.description: Clears the entire cache, optionally updating the last configuration reference.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.resetIfConfigChanged
methods.description: Resets the cache if the configuration has changed since the last stored reference.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.pruneExpired
methods.description: Removes expired entries based on the current time and TTL.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.evictToMaxSize
methods.description: Evicts oldest entries until cache size is within the maximum size limit.

ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, CacheEntry<T>>();$/
